Here at Jo Loves, creativity is at the heart of everything we do. The Shot Candle™ concept allows you to be a Scent Artist by creating your very own unique candle scent. Once lit, you’ll first experience the scent of the Shot, then a blend of both fragrances and lastly the Base scent. Allowing you to enjoy three different fragrant moments in one experience. No matter what two fragrances you choose they will sit together beautifully. The Shot Candle™ may burn slightly differently to our usual Home Candles due to the way they are created for your specific fragrance choices therefore a slight 'tunnelling' may appear. This is normal and is due to the shot melting into the base of the candle. Housed in an artisanal hand-blown glass jar, each Shot Candle™ has a burn time of approximately 60 hours.
